name: Choir Invisible
body:
School illusion (figment); Level bard 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration 1 round/2 levels (D)

DESCRIPTION

You complete the spell and an invisible ghostly chorus picks up on your performance. If you are doing an auditory bardic performance (or similar ability like skald raging song) the chorus will continue to maintain the song to the duration of the spell while you can stop maintaining it with your bardic performance rounds.

At the end of the spell the maintained performance ends and you can start a new performance. You cannot have two concurrent bardic performances with this spell.
